environment: reference build: Linux x86_64 container, Python 3.13
method: pip into /opt/sectools-venv (symlinked to /usr/local/bin) for Python tools; pinned GitHub release binaries for Go tools
note: Install state on the reference build at the time in recorded_at. It describes that machine only. The running platform works out each tool's state itself (it looks the program up on PATH and asks it for its version); run 'make verify' for the states on your machine.

trivy.reason: The Trivy release archive could not be downloaded on the reference build, so the binary was not installed there. The connector is implemented and was not run. pip-audit and OSV-Scanner cover dependency scanning.
